links.comparator_used: Single LLM models (single-model agreement) for error detection; the lowest-agreement stratum is implicitly compared with exhaustive review
links.outcome: Detection of human annotation errors to prioritize annotations for targeted review
links.effect: Human error rates rose from 0% at agreement scores 3-4 to 76% at score 0. The lowest-agreement stratum was 6.5% of annotations but held an estimated 80% of errors. Prevalence-adjusted AUC-ROC was 0.991 (95% CI 0.987-0.994) and AUC-PR was 0.893 (95% CI 0.851-0.929).
links.quote: Multi-LLM disagreement outperformed single models and provided graded operating points for risk-stratified review.

design_hint: multi-LLM disagreement to prioritize human annotations for targeted review
